verdict.rationale: Greptile's docs describe several handoff paths. Every review comment has a "Fix with your Agent" button that sends file paths, line numbers and suggested code to Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Conductor or Devin, and a "Fix All" button sends every issue at once. An official MCP server connects Cursor, Claude Code and Codex to fetch unaddressed comments and apply fixes, with /check-pr and /greploop commands. `greptile review --agent` outputs each finding as raw text with a suggested fix for an agent to apply. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the agent handoff works as documented.
